This one was a several different dreams all rolled into one.

I was working on a passenger vessel as one of the crewmen. Eventually, we docked and everyone went home. I was invited to have dinner with the Captain and his girlfriend, my my mom, and brother also showed up.

(I'm loosing details of the Dream as I write) but dinner was very good and they had a small kitten who climbed up my leg and up my back and rested on my shoulder as I ate.

We finished, left and started going on a drive in an RV and it turns out we were driving in Ukraine, it was a beautiful sunny day clear skies and my mother and I met my Aunt.

Then things get jumbled up, some how there are more people in the RV than just my mom and brother, we get pulled over and I realize that these "people" are looking for me so I hide in the RV bathroom but I'm given away as the people looking for me start singing and Rhyming as they come closer to the bathroom and uncover me.

As they take me away I Break free run downstairs open the door and now somehow I'm in a "yuuuuge" hotel ballroom with this hot chick and we are dancing. Or rather we try to but she is a very bad dancer and everytime I try to swing her she goes the opposite way or almost stumbles into people. Anyway, we run again, from this room down another hall and come into another ballroom that is having a very fancy reception with people, luckily we are both dressed up, me in a suit her in an floral gown. There are people we both know at this reception and they tell us hi. She stops to talk to someone and I didn't notice until after I left the room and end up standing outside.

It's a beautiful sunny day, but a bit colder there is some snow on the ground. I car jack a vehicle and start driving back Home to where I used to live growing up without the girl who was previously with me.

When I'm there I pull over across from the house. There is a wide pull off that has a face of a mountain side on the end of it. I get out of the vehicle and start walking to stretch my legs, when I get back I realize that there is 5 feet of water and it's starting to float the car away.

[this is where it gets weird] some young people also drive on the highway and pull over to talk to us and we all realize that it's starting to flood and rain really hard--the "Flood" is happening. One of the strangers who pulled over says, "quick follow me" and he walks to the face of the mountain clicks a button that wasn't there a minute ago and elevator doors open up.

We walk in and then I realize I. Am. Batman. As we decend in the elevator with water dripping everywhere I'm dressed like batman but over my black Kevlar suit I'm also wearing chain mail. We are descending for awhile and I say out loud to myself, "this whole thing is an extraterrestrial ship!"

Elevator doors open we all step out and there are three or four hunched over goblin aliens that each have two big perfectly round black eyes on either side of their head. Two eyes stacked on top of each other (instead of perpendicular like in most movies), they are all holding these zapper spears, then out from behind them comes a black guy who is a "super alien" he looks like a human but he somehow I know he is an alien and he has a weird looking gun and starts shooting everyone around me--they fall down instantly---it's a stun gun.

He shoots me and the plasma shreds my suit and hits me to the core, I can't breathe I tear of a chunk of my chain mail from my left arm and throw it at his face. It Knicks his left eye and he starts to bleed but by then I'm able to run away as he continues to shoot at me.

Next scene. I'm in a storage area of the alien ship with large crates and boxes all around me, up above me are ramp parts and walk ways and the goblin aliens come out of the walls all holding zapper sticks and their eyes now glowing blue instead of being black all looking at me.

I can barely breathe, it's very shallow. And I break down and start crying, "why?" I yell as I can feel the super human approach behind me. "Why dear God, why?!" I yell louder. Behind me I hear the super human ask, "what did you say?"

But his question doesn't register in my mind, I'm sobbing and pounding my fist on the ground, "dear God why did you do this?!"

By then everyone in the massive room hears me and they start whispering to themselves, all I can hear occasionally is "God....god...god..."

The superhuman comes up to me now, I turn to look and he has a very stern look on his face and says, "Come, I need to show you something"

Then some asshole called me and I woke up.

The weird thing is that, I have a feeling I've had parts of that dream before, because it felt familiar.

I saw this post earlier today that said that Voat was giving too much power to its users; I was about to respond that in a democracy you can't give too much power to the people, but then I thought about people like Amalek who create alternate accounts, effectively giving themselves more power than people who don't in the grand Voat democracy. So what does that leave us with, something like a Tempocracy? A system in which those with more free time are given greater power? How can you fix that without violating each voting user's privacy?
Can Voat, or other sites, be a true democracy without personal identification?

One cannot be concerned with such minor things.

There will always be dickwads who desire to exploit the system and will be willing to jump through any hoops you make line up.

Identifying oneself will not remove this trait, the exploitative ones will just go and use other people that they know as their additional accounts' IDs.

A site must instead focus on keeping users engaged in the site and rewarded for that engagement. They need to see a positive outcome to their voting on everything they see, that the site takes shape around their efforts. Their positive outcome will be rewarded for the site in new users who are encouraged to join in.

The ideal is that you remove the problem not by removing the problem, but by drowning it out. Bring in enough real users who are engaged and invested and you will not be able to warp the site enough to be noticed.

the exploitative ones will just go and use other people that they know as their additional accounts' IDs.

That thought crossed my mind, but doesn't that happen in real life too? How many people are there who vote based on how their friends/family vote, rather than actually tackle the issues and decide for themselves?

Exactly.

Ignore the unavoidable problem and focus on the highest rewarding work.

Implementing an ID system does not help, making more users really want to vote on things is what helps.

So then does it become necessary to form some kind of PSA system to educate the users on this? I don't think many users naturally think this way, especially not those who come from places like Reddit, where the population is so high that people have given up on voting entirely. In my time on Reddit, the only time I upvoted anything was when I wrote a comment on it that I wanted to be seen; and that's a mentality that's kind of followed me here and I imagine I'm not alone in that.
